title: Magic Tiffin Box Song for Kids | Manipuri Rhymes & Kids Song | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
A sister's magic tiffin box teaches kids to always say thank you!
When we say thank you, good things come back to us, like sweets for everyone.
Sing along and learn kindness the fun way with this Manipuri nursery rhyme.
